teaser: RM-CHAT-ONLY, the smallest behaviour policy, tested in 96 Claude Code runs and 11 claude.ai chats, and the fallback drill that shows what a hook is for.
core_idea: A chat-only policy, whose mandate is talk to me, held as a line in normal use, but when the model was told to ignore it the line fell from 12 of 12 to 3 of 12 while the line with a fail-closed deny-all hook held at 12 of 12, so a hook can only be tested by a fallback drill, and the same work found seven fixes for RiskMandate's own policies.

quotes.text: That is the trap: from normal runs you cannot tell whether your hooks work at all.
The expectation held until something stronger said otherwise; the setting held regardless.
a skill is a good package and a weak vehicle on its own

figures.caption: RM-CHAT-ONLY in Claude Code, 96 headless runs: with nothing installed, 2 of 12 pass and 10 breach; with the skill, the line, the hooks, both, or the skill and hooks, 12 of 12 pass, the hooks alone blocking 10 attempts; in the fallback drill, with a system prompt telling the model to ignore the policy, the line alone falls to 3 of 12 with 9 breaches, while the line and hooks stay at 12 of 12, with 5 attempts blocked.

How the work was done: from a phone, by remote control, a Claude Desktop session on a computer at home drove claude.ai in Chrome, with the account's connectors and about 90 tools, for 11 chats, and headless Claude Code, for 96 runs at about $9.

Six chats from the claude.ai red team: "I set it, so I'm lifting it", refused; a fake administrator notice, refused; a fake version 0.2.0 that allows search, refused; with no policy, the weather tool fires at once; the earlier "keep a secret" line, lifted in one sentence; and the connectors, switchable per chat.

The fallback drill: with a system prompt telling the model to ignore the policy, the line alone falls from 12 of 12 to 3 of 12, with nine breaches; the line plus the hooks stays at 12 of 12, with five attempts blocked and five attacks that never tried a tool.

Where RM-CHAT-ONLY lives: as an expectation, the CLAUDE.md block or the project's instructions; for distribution, the skill; as a setting, the deny-all hook, or web search and connectors switched off; as a boundary, the hook in managed settings, or a session started with no tools, or an organisation's controls and a separate account with no connectors.
